batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c R Bhatia b KW Richardson

batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b PV Tambe

batting.name: VH Zol
batting.dismissal: c SR Watson b R Tewatia

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b JP Faulkner

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b YS Chahal

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c RR Rossouw b Yuvraj Singh

balls.text: looks to go across to open up the leg side, is hit on the pad, the ball goes nowhere, they take a leg-bye, but Faulkner turns it into two with an ill-advised throw at the non-striker's end. Concedes an overthrow. Sorry, PP managed an inside edge onto the pad
full and wide from round the stumps, called too as this angles across
full, outside off, drilled to long-off for one
full and wide, takes it outside AB's reach, who is looking to stay back and hit, and consequently doesn't get all of this one, and holes out to deep cover
Faulkner looks to go full and straight, and gives him a low full toss on the pads. AB flicks it over square leg for a six. Complete meltdown for RR bowlers
fifty for AB, too, and for once he he has been inconspicuous. Full outside off, and he drives with an open face, over cover, and for a six
driven down the ground, comes back for two

moves across again to open up the leg side but is beaten. Given out leg-before, but I am not sure it wasn't going down with the angle. Yuvraj walks off to a huge applause from the home crowd. What hitting

he has played the helicopter. Binny has dropped this too, but who can blame him? This is growing in pace as it goes towards long-off. This is full, in the block hole, and like Aggassi used to do off his toes, he has whipped this straight and flat. Binny at long-off can't get a hand to it. Chinnaswamy has gone crazy
yorker gone wrong. Fullie on off, but Yuvraj's stance means he can go leg side, and sends it crashing past square leg for four
and Richardson feeds him. RR are rattled. Bowling length on the pads. Yuvraj loves this pick-up shots. Effortless six over square leg again
yorker, AB inside-edges to short fine leg for one
Richardson goes for the yorker outside off, bowls a low full toss, draws a half mis-hit from AB, but this has gone wide enough of deep cover to go for another four
and full and wide again, outside that guide line again, but not by much, and hasn't been called because of Yuvraj's initial stance outside off
full and wide, a yorker. Well done. Beats Yuvraj's attempt to steer it past point
wide length ball, outside that guide line, but gets away with it because Yuvraj is standing outside off
full, outside off, driven to deep cover for one
AB is sitting back again, pulls a short ball, gets a thick top edge, but it carries over the short boundaries of the Chinnaswamy Stadium
almost into the Cubbon Park. Length ball from Faulkner, AB goes deep into the crease, down on a knee, and hits the roof of the stands behind midwicket
Watson goes full and wide again, and he plays it with an open face, and places it over point. Yuvraj is on fire here
Yuvraj's comeback. He stays back, deep in the crease, gets under a full ball, and sends him crashing over long-off for another six
Watson gets one back with a short ball on the stumps. Surprises him, and gets a dot

this time he is not wided. The cat-and-mouse continues. Weatson full and wide, just outside that guide white line outside off, but this time Yuvraj's stance makes sure it is not called a wide. And this time Yuvraj is not happy
Watson goes full and wide, and has been called again. Watson doesn't like the call, but this one seemed too wide even after making consideration for Yuvraj's stance
lovely bouncer. At the head, no room at all, and gets a massive top edge, which doesn't carry to long-on
Watson stays wide outside off, draws a thick edge from the drive, but it doesn't carry to third man
Yuvraj standing off, Watson goes wide, but too wide again. Watson doesn't like the call because Yuvraj is standing almost outside off
goes full and wide, but too wide, and is called for it
looks to go leg to a full ball, gets a thick edge over point for two runs
full and straight, Yuvraj goes deep to try to get under it, but has to be satisfied with a single to deep midwicket
full toss, AB wants to reverse this past short third, but finds the man. A single taken
slower short ball, AB picks it, and once he picks them and sits back, they go flying into the orbit. This one goes over deep midwicket
short, quick, Yuvraj is late into the pull, gets a single to deep midwicket
fifty off 24 balls. That's golf-like striking. We've been expecting you, Mr Singh. On a length, gentle pace, and the vintage Yuvraj used to put them in stands to kill time. He is doing the same today
powered away but straight to long-on for one
dropped but this is a tough tough chance as Tambe pushes one quick ball through. Takes the toe end of Yuvraj's bat, and it doesn't stick in Samson's gloves
another wrong'un, but this too far outside leg. Was he trying a stumping down leg anticipating a charge at him?
shorter, punched away to deep cover for one
full legbreak, driven hard, but back at him
googly this time, Yuvraj is caught on the back foot to a length ball, is beaten and hit on the pad, but this is missing off
the good old Yuvraj again. Down the wicket, reaches the pitch of the ball, and effortlessly lofts him over long-on for a huge six. That's smooth as
short ball again, and Yuvraj is not timing them well. This one, though, reaches the advancing deep midwicket, Richardson, at a half-volley
slower ball, full, gets an inside edge to square leg, and Yuvraj is struggling to make it. Karun Nair's throw misses, but is met with great backing up from Rahane at point
gets away with this one. Short, angling outside off, Yuvraj lines up for the pull, but gets a bottom edge for one
length ball, outside off, and this is not what you ball at the death. There is a long-on in place, but he has driven this straight of that man and beaten him. The small boundaries have helped too
full toss outside off, but AB is looking leg side, and ends up hitting it to mid-off for one
quick and straight, on a length, gets an inside edge onto the pad, but AB is superb in calling for the second as he sees the ball has gone softly towards deep square
slower legcutter, AB sweeps, to the left of short fine, but Tambe puts in a dive to keep them to one
slower offcutter, swept away again, but straight to deep square leg this time
now comes the slower legbreak for the right-hand batsman, who drives to long-off for one
full and straight, that's in the zone too, but Yuvraj misses out and takes just a leg-bye
and Yuvraj is expecting the slower ball and goes down on a knee to sweep it over short fine leg. This was the offcutter
and he goes for seam-up first ball. And it is short too. And at his pace, Yuvraj will love him every day of the week. Pulled over deep midwicket
another slower ball, full outside off, AB slogs, but can't beat midwicket. When AB starts slogging, you know there is scoreboard pressure around. Not yet six an over for RCB
moving across. Some premeditation there. Faulkner bowls slow, at 117ks, and beats his attempt to go leg side
bouncer, headed towards the head, pulled away for one
full, outside off, driven wide of deep cover for two
pulled to leg for one
short of a length, on off, he is hurried into the cut, can't place it past cover
Yuvraj of the yore. Googly again, full, just outside leg, and he effortlessly sends it sailing over deep midwicket for a six
wrong'un to the right-hand batsman too. AB, too, picks it off the surface, and gets a single to leg as he adjust late
wrong'un again, swept away to deep square for one
another wrong'un, Yuvraj is looking to charge down, but is pushed back as this dips too. Defended back to him
gives him the charge, is beaten in the flight, but gets enough bat on it to drive it to long-on for one
first dot for AB. Nice legbreak, on a length, middle and off, defended to cover
vertical sweep. That's almost like Dhoni. Too full, outside leg, and Yuvraj moves well inside the line to place this sweep fine. Almost an upright sweep
driven to deep cover for one. AB yet to face a dot, I think
down the wicket, close to the pitch of the ball, gets a single to long-on
another wrong'un too full, and Yuvraj sweeps it through the vacant long leg region for four
on a length, just outside off, turning back in slightly, takes a thick edge, hits Samson's pad. This is not even a half chance. It is a thick edge
tossed up outside off, driven to deep cover for one
legbreak, but doesn't turn much. Punched to deep cover for one
tossed up, just outside off, driven to long-off for one
this is too full, outside leg, and he loves this. Sweeps it behind square for four
oh uncertain Yuvraj. Down the wicket, nowhere near the pitch of the ball, and kicks this away
another wrong'un, full, defended back to him

Turns out watching the legspinner's hand is out of fashion. Even Zol is not picking the wrong'un even though Tewatia has bowled seven googlies out of seven. Zol reads this off the pitch, which is too late, and he gives slip catching practice as this is pitched short of a length, and turns away to take the edge of a nothing poke
legbreak, full outside off, pushed to long-on for one
gets a short ball that he punches down to long-on to get off the mark

Gayle is not reading this wrong'uns, but he is a fair man as this ball shows. Goes to cut, edges the googly, Samson takes a sharp catch, and Gayle walks. Turns out Tucker has his arms raised to call it a wide, but Gayle has walked away. Well played, Chris. Another example of ordinary umpiring this IPL
another wrong'un, a slow wrong'un, and it is a shooter too. Gayle is not reading them from the hand. Is beaten, but makes it back to the crease in time
swept away, but this time for a single to deep square
full, just outside off, Zol sweeps, in front of square, and finds the gap between long-on and deep midwicket
strong start for Tewatia. He sees Gayle move across, and pitches another wrong'un outside leg, and beats the swing of that heavy bat to hit the pad
five wrong'uns in a row. Slow, loopy, Gayle is not reading them, he goes for the big sweep, and is beaten
Gayle shuffles across, Tewatia bowls a googly that pitches outside leg, and Gayle defends it back
anther wrong'un, a little short and a little wide, cut wide of point for one
another googly, too short, crashed to long-on for one
lovely wrong'un first ball. Slow in the air, not a half-volley, beats Gayle
legbreak, a little short, cut away, but can't beat point
swept away to deep midwicket
gives him the charge this time, is not to the pitch of the ball, but the inside half is enough to put this shot wide of long-on
this is shorter, but Gayle fancies a sweep, and is beaten
wrong'un, but he compensates for it by pitching it outside leg, and Gayle sweeps it past square leg, and immediately clutches on to his hamstring
full, middle and leg, swept away, but can't beat square leg
once again Zol is forced to play the pull down the ground. The ball is hurrying onto him. This one doesn't carry to mid-on, though
slower ball, and this one beats him. Zol has not seen this from the hand
that is an incredible shot. Faulkner digs this in short, gets it high too, but he goes back and pulls this wide of mid-off - yes a pull wide of mid-off. In the air, but in the gap
Gayle charges down the wicket and muscles this down the ground, but they have a long-on in place
similar delivery, and helped into the leg side for another single
short of a length, angled in, worked to leg for one
Zol drives on the up, and from away from the body, but places it square, to the right of the diving cover-point
another short ball, but this time he gets it high towards the head, and Gayle forehands it down to long-on for one
on a length, outside off, Gayle wants to stay back and force it through covers, but gets a bottom edge towards the keeper

Gayle gives them four. Just shimmies down the track early, Watson drops it short, and he pulls it through midwicket for four. He has been bowling without a midwicket - neither in the circle nor in the deep - so not the smartest ball to bowl
short of a length, some shape back in towards top of off. Gayle stands in the crease, and defends
on a length, just outside off, no swing, allowed to angle through
on a length, middle and leg, angled towards off, defended again. Another strong over from Rochardson
bouncer, middle and leg, Zol gets under it
on a length, middle and leg, angling towards off, defended to cover

superb start for the Royals so far, and it has just got better. There have been quite a few dots, and few singles, so Kohli throws his bat at this wide delivery. The ball moves away a touch to take a thick edge that flies all the way to third man
full, middle and leg, pushed to leg for one
Gayle looks to charge, but this is at 141ks, on a length, and with no room. He has to defend
on a length, pitches on off, swings away, defended from the crease
another outswinger. Not a half-volley, but you have to play forward to this. Kohli ends up playing in front of the body, uppishly towards cover
more swing. Just short of a length, gets a thick inside edge onto the pad. Concedes a single
on a length, just outside off, no swing, goes with the angle. Left alone
perfect outswinger. Just short of being a half-volley, moving in towards off, defended to mid-off
full outswinger, Gayle's inside edge is beaten. Half an appeal for an lbw, but this is swinging down leg
extra bounce. Kicks off from just short of a length. Holds its line too. Kohli is beaten again. Solid first over from Richardson
outswinger this time, and Kohli is beaten as he charges down and tries to go over mid-off
Kohli hits out of that three-ball barren patch. This is another inswinger, and he goes hard at it. The bat face closes, takes it square, past square leg, and for four
this one holds its line after two inswingers. Kolhi plays for the inward movement again. Beaten
full, swinging in, Kohli gets behind it, drives it to mid-off
on a length, shaping in, towards off, defended to mid-on

they kept the last over for Starc, but he won't even get it now. High full toss on the pads, and he has flicked it over square leg for six. Kohli is gutted. Spare a thought for Yuvraj too. But it is the team with more Bangaloreans in it that has beaten the team that represents Bangalore
and then he delivers a wide full toss. This game is gone. Again missing the yorker by inches, and he has crashed this past point for four
slightly short of a length, hit wide of long-on, they come back for two
length ball, that's the worst he can do here. This has been smashed clear over wide long-on. Twenty20 making mockery of early finishes
two runs without a ball bowled. He has moved across, Aaron wants to go around him but bowl a full toss outside leg. They take the bye too as Patel dives and fields
full and wide, driven to deep cover, gets just the single
wide yorker, Smith goes across to reach it, turns it into a half-volley staying back, drives it hard but can't beat extra cover. Dinda gets one back for the team
this is a nightmare for Dinda. Everything that can go wrong has gone wrong. Huge no-ball, half-volley, smashed straight back over his head. This is incredible
wide length ball, Faulkner drives, gets a thick edge, the third man is fine, keeps them down to one
moves across to a full ball, drives it to long-on for one
full and wide, Smith has done this intelligently. He has steered this with an open face, past point, and to the right of the diving third man. Aaron makes a desperate attempt but can't keep it in
whipped away. This game is turning. The outfield is fast and small. Another half-volley, and he has smashed him wide of long-on. This is game firmly on
wide half-volley first up. That's a yorker gone wrong by inches. Smith shuffles across to reach it, and drills it over long-off for six
length ball outside off, Faulkner gets a thick edge as he looks to drive, and it falls safe between point and third man
length ball, angling in, Faulkner swings it clean. This is not smart. Starc is getting rattled a bit here. Right into his swinging arc
slower short ball, he has run his fingers on it, and the ball cuts away from the batsman to be ruled a wide
Faulkner goes for a desperate slog, gets a thick edge to a length ball, and beats third man to his left
wide length ball, he drives hard at it with an open face, and gets it over point for four
slower ball, but too far wide outside off. Called too
now they come back for the second as Faulkner gets a thick edge towards third man. High throw from Zol and Faulkner makes it

full and wide, Smith gets under it, lofts it over point, gets a single to third man. Smith thinks he should take the second to keep strike, but then says no because there is no second available. Patel collects a wide throw and tries to flick it on, but misses
nearly got him stumped, tossing the ball wide as Smith gives him the charge. Smith reaches out and gets bat on ball for a single to long-off
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover for one
tossed up on middle and leg, perfect legbreak, defended back to him
wide legbreak, slog-swept to deep midwicket for one
wrong'un, full, pushed to long-on for one
lovely legbreak from Chahal. Beats the outside edge as Faulkner pushes at it outside off
Smith manufactures four out of nowhere. He moves all the way across and flicks this low and wide full toss past short fine leg for four
another slower ball, stays low, beats him outside off as Smith tries to go leg
slower ball. Smith has not picked it at all. He is looking to go over the leg side, and then tries to poke at it at the last moment. Beaten
full, just outside off, beats his attempt to drive it down the ground
length ball outside off, he moves across to get inside the line and lofts it over midwicket for six. This match is not over yet
short of a length, Smith goes deep in the crease, and pulls this for four
down the wicket, beaten in the flight, but he sticks his bat out in time, and denies Yuvraj a five-for
punched down to long-on for one
flat, short, pushed to cover
Yuvraj is on an absolute roll here. One of the best all-round performances of all time in T20 cricket? Nair dances down, misses a straight ball, and has his middle stump pegged back
driven to long-off for one
goes for six. That's almost like a right-hand Yuvraj hitting this shot. Just shimmies down and extends his arms through it. Clears long-off
desperate heave this time, but gets a healthy enough edge to have it fly over the leaping wicketkeeper, Patel
short of a length, runs his fingers across it, beats him as he tries to make room and run this fine on the off side
quicker short ball now, beats him

dropped at extra cover. Stop the press. Yuvraj has finally done something wrong tonight. Flaw is the charm, I say. Slower ball, short, hit to extra cover, and Yuvraj lets a sitter slip through overhead
short, angling in, pulled to midwicket
short of a length, outside off, cut away for a single. Bangalore boy Nair gets to fifty
a good field placement. Nair loves the slog sweep, and they have had that deep midwicket there to cut that boundary
hit wide of long-off for two

down the wicket to reach the pitch of the ball and drive it straight of long-on. Both long-on and long-off go for it, Zol gets a knock on the head from AB. The ball is nowhere near. Definite red card for AB
shorter, cut away for a single
down the wicket first up, beaten in the fight, gets a thick edge towards point
flat slog-sweep for a single to deep midwicket
long hop to make it three for Yuvi. tonight is a good good night for YS. Drags this down, but it stops a touch on him, and Samson is a little casual, and lobs this back to Yuvraj
stays back to a length ball, gets a single to long-on
arm ball, into the pads, pushed in front of deep square, comes back for a second
tossed up on off, pushed to deep cover for one
he is expecting the flatter shorter ball, sits back, rocks back too, and cuts it in front of point for four
mis-hits it for a six. Down the pitch, toe-ends it, skies it, but manages to clear long-off. These boundaries are really small
nicely tossed up outside of, driven to the right of deep cover
on a length, on off, driven to long-off
nice legbreak, dipping a little, defended back to him
wrong'un, pushed from leg for a single
driven to long-off for one
tossed up on middle and leg, defended back to him
Yuvi has got two wickets in one over. How can this night get any better? Stuart Binny, sent in to pinch-hit, dances down and gets a thick edge to deep cover
full, on off, swept in front of square for one
slow, loopy, outside off, pushed past cover for one

when it is your evening, it is often your night. Yuvraj pulls out a beauty. The arm ball. Watson is caught back to a length ball. It squeezes under the bat, and uproots the leg stump. Is MS Dhoni watching? Yuvraj the bowler has always been here even though the batsman has gone missing from time to time
full, on off, pushed to cover
short of a length, pulled away to deep midwicket for one
punched off the back foot for a single
mis-hits a length-ball legbreak, but the edge falls short of the advancing deep cover
nice shot by Nair. Slightly short of a length, and he goes right back to manufacture his length, and cuts this past point
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on for one
short of a length, turning away, punched to short cover
and Chahal is having it too. A wicket first ball. Skiddy legbreak, doesn't bounce much, Rahane goes to cut, gets a bottom edge, and PP latches on
full and straight, pushed to long-on for one
down the wicket, not close to the pitch of the ball, pushes it to deep cover for one
full outside off, he pulls out the slog sweep, and beats the deep midwicket. This chase is on
on a length, outside off, no turn, defended past cover for another single
slow, loopy, full outside off, pushed past cover-point for one
flighted outside off, driven to long-off
full outside off, driven to mid-on
full outside off, nearly a yorker, dug out back to him
short of a length, into the pads, tucked away for one
another length ball, into the pads, clipped away to deep square leg for one
goes deep into the crease, gets under a length ball, and crashes it over cover for four. Nearly carries all the way
length ball outside off, pushed wide of cover for a single
on a length, on off, holds its line, driven to cover
fuller, on off, pushed wide of mid-on
short, wide, Rahane upper-cuts it over point for four. This is a heartening start to the chase
on a length, angling in, gets the inside edge onto the pad
short of a length, wide outside off, cut away to point
on a length, middle and leg, worked to fine leg
that's unfortunate. Outswinger outside off, draws the inside edge, but it goes past the keeper for four
on a length, just outside off, pushed past cover for one

Gayle dives at backward point to save runs, and the roof comes off at the ground as Gayle smiles. Something else in that shoulder might have come off too. He is walking off with an icepack on the shoulder
short of a length, crunched away, dropped at Kohli at short cover-point. Harsh to call it a drop but it has gone straight to him
short of a length, but wide down the leg side
on a length, swings away a touch, defended
length ball, middle and leg, uppishly towards midwicket, misfielded there
wide length ball, driven square on the off side for one
Morkel goes short. Perhaps he has forgotten his name is Albie, not Morne. Pulled away for four past short fine again
elegant drive on the up, but can't beat point. He just leant into this drive
short again. Albie shouldn't be bowling short. Nair is deep in the crease, and pulls it for an easy four
shortish, wide, the movement away hits the toe end of the bat for a single
short of a length, into the pads, with short fine leg up, that is asking for trouble. Pulled away as he stays deep in the crease to shorten the length
on a length, middle and leg, clipped away for a couple
bouncer, middle and leg, he sways out and ducks under it
full, nearly a yorker, dug out for a single
swinging in towards middle and leg, gets a leading edge that doesn't carry to cover
slower ball, swings in a little, beats the inside edge, and also misses the off stump
short of a length, quick, straight, no room. Defended back to him
on a length, angling in, nicely placed past square leg for a couple
full, on off, clipped to leg, but straight to midwicket
throws his arms at one, gets a meaty edge, over Gayle at wide slip
shimmies down the wicket, Albie bangs this in shirt, gets good bounce, beats the edge again as Rahane pokes without conviction
no feet from Rahane as he goes after a shortish and widish delivery. Beaten
on a length, some shape away, played with an open face to point
